meta.name: RESQNET Disaster Scenarios
meta.description: Three prepared 20x20 disaster maps. Failure conditions live in failure_scenarios.json; drones in drone_config.json. No coordination mode is recommended here: the system must derive it from the conditions.
meta.coordinate_system: origin top-left; x = column 0-19 (left to right); y = row 0-19 (top to bottom); cell label = column letter A-T + row number 1-20 (x=1,y=3 -> B4)
meta.movement_model: 4-neighbour grid moves; blocked and restricted cells are not enterable

map_legend.searched: green - searched, no candidate in simulated observation (not proof of safety)
map_legend.in_progress: yellow - search in progress or needs verification
map_legend.priority: red - high-priority area or unresolved candidate

meta.detection_note: Detections are unconfirmed observations. A rescue may only be shown as confirmed if the backend emits an explicit confirmation event.
meta.zone_scheme: 16 priority zones of 5x5 cells, Z01-Z16 row-major from top-left. simulated_risk_score is synthetic, derived from documented rules, not a real survivor probability.
meta.synthetic_data_notice: All values are initial test parameters, not real-world operating specifications.
